name: glyhub_GPST000170_N
title: Ion-source dopant effects on N-glycan signal
description: Targeted peak areas for 15 selected N-glycan features measured in technical injection replicates under six ion-source gas/dopant conditions.
details: The panel compares AIR, nitrogen and solvent-enriched nitrogen conditions using three injections per condition. This is the complete author-defined 15-feature targeted panel, not an unbiased whole-glycome survey. Isomer suffixes remain separate; Sg denotes Neu5Gc. Relative area summaries and signal-to-noise statistics are not mistaken for extra samples. The N-glycan sample is a 1:1 mixture released from human IgG and bovine fetuin; the O-glycan sample derives from bovine submaxillary mucin. Each run injected 1 microlitre.
annotation: Source molecular compositions retained without inferring glycosidic linkages.

name: glyhub_GPST000170_O
title: Ion-source dopant effects on O-glycan signal
description: Targeted peak areas for 15 selected O-glycan features measured in technical injection replicates under six ion-source gas/dopant conditions.
details: The panel compares AIR, nitrogen and solvent-enriched nitrogen conditions using three injections per condition. This is the complete author-defined 15-feature targeted panel, not an unbiased whole-glycome survey. Isomer suffixes remain separate; Sg denotes Neu5Gc. name: glyhub_GPST000190_N
title: Linkage-specific sialic-acid derivatization of plasma N-glycans
description: Background-subtracted extracted-ion intensities of procainamide-labelled plasma N-glycans after linkage-specific sialic-acid derivatization.
details: The deposited complete extraction table contains 39 composition/retention features in two charge states across 54 LC-MS runs, including explicitly labelled blanks. Charge states remain separate measurement features rather than being summed without an author-defined rule. Am and E denote the source derivatization products used to distinguish alpha2,3- and alpha2,6-linked sialic acids; their counts are retained alongside the underlying Neu5Ac composition. Unmeasured charge states and reported zeros are missing in the curated assay. Run identifiers retain the original experimental batches; they are not interpreted as independent biological donors.
annotation: Composition-level glycans with source charge, retention time, procainamide label, and linkage-specific sialic-acid derivative counts; no full topology inferred.

name: glyhub_GPST000211_O
title: O-glycans released by thrombin-activated human platelets
description: Released O-glycan peak areas from platelet releasates of five human donors following thrombin stimulation.
details: The published total-AUC columns combine the author-measured charge states for each of eleven glycan features. Isomer-resolved features remain distinct. Glycans below 300 Da were outside the reported detection range. Proposed source structures and their known linkages are retained where explicitly represented; the trisialylated feature has unresolved sialic-acid attachment topology and retains composition-level annotation.
annotation: Source composition counts and proposed structures cross-checked against the source table images and deposited GlycoWorkbench workspace; unresolved topology remains missing.

name: glyhub_GPST000296_N
title: Oral tumor N-glycans associated with lymph node metastasis
description: Relative abundances of 83 isomer-resolved N-glycan features from 31 oral squamous cell carcinoma tumors with or without lymph node metastasis.
details: The complete source matrix contains 12 N0 and 19 N+ tumor samples. Glycan isomers remain distinct and source MS/MS confirmation, retention time, core fucosylation, bisecting GlcNAc and sialic-acid diagnostics are retained. Eighty-two partial structures combine the source spectral atlas with explicit sialic-acid linkage information from Table S3; unnumbered linkages and unresolved arms remain unknown. Feature 9b has no MS/MS-confirmed topology and retains composition only. Analytes were reduced glycans; this preparation is recorded separately from monosaccharide identity.
annotation: Source spectral-atlas topologies with TS3-supported sialic linkages; unnumbered linkages and uncertain arms retained as unknown. Composition-only annotation for 9b.
table: Deposited Glycan_results.xlsx, TS3; published supplementary spectral atlas

name: glyhub_GPST000460_N
title: Cardiac N-glycomes in fatal COVID-19
description: N-glycan MS1 peak areas from cardiac tissue and isolated cardiomyocytes of COVID-positive and COVID-negative donors.
details: Four source tables are combined by exact composition-plus-retention labels, normalizing only GU/RRT notation and spacing. The sample metadata distinguishes FFPE tissue from isolated cardiomyocytes and COVID status. Features absent from a source table remain missing rather than zero. Maltodextrin calibration ladders and class summaries are excluded. Published GlyTouCan structures are linked only when composition and retention position identify a unique annotation; inconsistent registry assignments remain unresolved. Clinical metadata uses exact published patient identifiers; abbreviated ambiguous cardiomyocyte IDs are not guessed.
annotation: Author glycan labels, additive monosaccharide counts, and uniquely matched registry structures. Source/registry annotation conflicts are preserved for review.

name: glyhub_GPST000473_N
title: N-glycan remodeling after TANGO2 loss
description: Relative abundances of 82 released N-glycan features in TANGO2 knockout and control cells, with three quantitative columns per genotype.
details: PGC-LC-MS profiling of PNGase F-released, reduced N-glycans examines cellular glycosylation changes associated with TANGO2 loss and altered cytoskeletal organization. The six individual source columns are retained; the figure caption reports five biological replicates for a broader panel but this table contains three per genotype. Likely source topologies are retained with unmarked linkages and bracketed attachments unresolved. The FA3 feature has conflicting shorthand and diagram annotations and therefore lacks typed glycan annotations.
annotation: Likely SNFG topologies transcribed from the source diagrams; uncertain linkages and bracketed terminal parents remain ambiguous. Source row 38 has a label/diagram conflict.

name: glyhub_GPST000534_N
title: N-glycan profiles of two tardigrade species
description: Published relative molar abundances of N-glycans isolated from Ramazzottius varieornatus and Hypsibius exemplaris.
details: The author table reports 24 identified glycan structures and an unresolved Others fraction for two species-level profiles. PA-labeled glycans were separated chromatographically; analytes sharing an LC peak remain separate by observed mass, using the author-reported MALDI intensity-based proportions. The source does not provide individual biological replicate columns, so these profiles cannot estimate within-species variation. Linkages explicitly drawn in the source are preserved; the unresolved aggregate has no typed glycan annotation.
annotation: Twenty-four source linkage diagrams independently checked against the rendered deposited table; Others retains missing composition and structure.
table: Deposited Table.docx, N-Glycans derived from R. varieornatus and H. exemplaris

name: glyhub_GPST000584_N
title: Serum N-glycan profiles across hepatocellular carcinoma progression
description: MALDI-TOF serum N-glycomics from the hepatocellular carcinoma study, retaining the complete published pre-processing abundance table.
details: The raw sheet of Supplementary Data 2 contains 201 composition features and 743 source observations. The separate processed sheet is a filtered, normalized subset and is not appended as independent samples. Published clinical fields from Supplementary Data 8 are joined by exact sample ID; unmatched samples retain missing clinical metadata. The assay contains original peak-area measurements, with source zeros represented as missing and no new imputation or normalization. Composition-level measurements do not establish glycan topology or linkage isomers. Disease groups are joined from explicit sample/group columns in the source-data workbook, without inferring groups from sample numbering.
annotation: Source molecular compositions retained without inferring glycosidic linkages.

name: glyhub_GPST000647_N
title: Whole-brain N-glycans in Slc35a3-deficient mice
description: N-glycan amounts in whole-brain tissue from wild-type, heterozygous and Slc 35 a 3-knockout mice, with three source observations per genotype.
details: The 179 rows include paucimannose, high-mannose, hybrid, neutral-complex and acidic-complex features. Paucimannose counts are literal; other source counts describe residues beyond the Hex 3 HexNAc 2 N-glycan core. Full compositions include this core, consistent with the reported mass series and the paper core-plus-HexNAc convention. Source alpha 2,3/alpha 2,6 sialic-acid counts are retained as partial linkage annotations; predicted SNFG cartoons are not promoted to experimentally resolved isomer structures.
annotation: Source-derived composition annotations; linkage information is retained as source annotation without inferring a full topology. No complete unambiguous structures are asserted.

name: glyhub_GPST000650_O
title: Whole-brain O-glycans in Slc35a3-deficient mice
description: O-glycan amounts in whole-brain tissue from wild-type, heterozygous and Slc 35 a 3-knockout mice, with three source observations per genotype.
details: The source study profiles nucleotide-sugar transporter deficiency using MALDI-TOF MS. Twenty-five annotated features are retained, including source-undetected rows. Sialic-acid linkage labels remain in row annotations; the paper describes composition-based assignments and does not resolve all isomeric structures. Quantitative zeros are represented as missing values, with original measurements and masks retained.
annotation: Source-derived composition annotations; linkage information is retained as source annotation without inferring a full topology. No complete unambiguous structures are asserted.

name: glyhub_GPST000625_N
title: Human intervertebral-disc N-glycan chromatographic profiles
description: Thirty-two shared HILIC-UPLC N-glycan peaks quantified in six biological replicates each of healthy and degenerated annulus fibrosus and nucleus pulposus tissue.
details: Dataset S2 contains the full individual-replicate percentage-area matrix. Glycan peaks may contain coeluting species, so peak identities are retained without assigning a single composition or structure. The separate 48-peak pooled-sample structural-deconvolution analysis is retained in the source workbook and is not equated to the 32-peak individual-replicate feature space. No glycan identities are inferred from peak numbers.
annotation: UPLC peak-level quantitative features; 32 individual-sample peaks cannot be uniquely matched to 48 pooled structural fractions. Composition and structure are intentionally missing; source peak identities are retained.

name: glyhub_GPST000601_N_glycopeptides
title: Rat serum N-glycopeptides across repeated sampling
description: Glycopeptide-level grouped abundances from albumin/IgG-depleted rat serum, sampled on five days in three female rats and one male rat.
details: Supplementary Table S2 provides 1256 quantified peptide-glycan feature rows. Grouped abundance columns are preserved on the published scale. Individual acquisition columns have mixed normalization labels and are retained only in the source workbook. Glycan acetyl counts are represented explicitly. A single protein site is assigned only when one protein position and one localized N-glycosylation site are unambiguous; all original peptide and protein mappings are retained.
annotation: Source-derived compositions and original annotation fields are preserved; unknown linkages are not inferred.

name: glyhub_GPST000601_N
title: Longitudinal rat-serum released N-glycans
description: Released serum N-glycan amounts from four female and four male rats sampled over five days, measured in 139 explicitly named technical MALDI acquisitions.
details: The complete quantitative-only (combine) export contains 14 features and 139 acquisition columns; repeated acquisitions are technical observations and must not be treated as independent animals. Source spot and run identifiers are retained, including the anomalous F1D4 E21 spot label. Assignment.pdf corroborates that complex-glycan codes omit the Man 3GlcNAc 2 core, whereas H5N2/H6N2 are full compositions. The final three source codes contain F1 but the diagram lacks fucose; their typed molecular annotation is missing while source labels and amounts remain intact. Unlocalized O-acetylation is represented at composition level only. Quantitative values are preserved in the reported pmol scale.
annotation: Source-derived compositions and original labels are retained. 6 source-supported structures are typed; unspecified bonds remain unknown. Unresolved or conflicting structures remain missing with source provenance.

name: glyhub_GPST000585_N
title: Bladder-tissue N-glycans across cancer stages
description: N-glycan profiles from healthy bladder, cystitis and Ta, T1 and muscle-invasive bladder tumours. The table contains five observations in each of the first four groups and eight in the muscle-invasive group.
details: PNGase F-released, reduced and permethylated N-glycans were quantified by mass spectrometry. Source Table S1 relative-abundance values are preserved without rescaling; paired peak areas are retained in row annotations rather than duplicating the dataset. n.d. cells are missing. Composition identities and source glycan classes are preserved without converting class labels into asserted structures.
annotation: Source-derived composition annotations; linkage information is retained as source annotation without inferring a full topology. No complete unambiguous structures are asserted.

name: glyhub_GPST000403_N
title: Rat serum N-glycans after chronic herbicide exposure
description: Serum N-glycan profiles from control and glyphosate-based-herbicide-exposed rats, comprising six control males, six control females, five exposed males and seven exposed females.
details: The 113-feature matrix is the final percentage matrix on Sheet 1, corroborated by published Supplementary Tables S1 and S2. Sheet 2 contains a differently normalised intermediate for the same samples and is not duplicated as independent observations. Five-digit glycan codes follow the paper order HexNAc, Hex, Fuc, NeuAc and NeuGc. Compositions are retained; structural isomers are unresolved.
annotation: Source-derived composition annotations; linkage information is retained as source annotation without inferring a full topology. No complete unambiguous structures are asserted.

name: glyhub_GPST000299_N
title: Onchocerca volvulus adult-female N glycan profile
description: A complete published MALDI peak-area profile from adult female Onchocerca volvulus, used to investigate shared antigenic glycans across filarial nematodes.
details: Table S4 supplies one profile per glycan class without biological-replicate columns. All measured peaks with numerical areas are retained, including unassigned peaks with missing molecular annotation. Areas are preserved without normalization and cannot support replicate-based statistical inference. Same-row SNFG topology is transcribed where unambiguous; unspecified glycosidic bonds and phosphocholine positions remain unknown. Ambiguous antenna attachment, alternative isomers or missing modification placement are retained in the source workbook rather than resolved by assumption. Analytical 2-AA is excluded from the native glycan annotation and recorded separately.
annotation: Source-derived compositions and original labels are retained. 19 source-supported structures are typed; unspecified bonds remain unknown. Unresolved or conflicting structures remain missing with source provenance.

title: Colorectal-cancer cell-line glycosphingolipid glycans
description: Relative glycosphingolipid-glycan abundances across 22 human colorectal-cancer cell lines spanning unassigned, undifferentiated and colon-like transcriptional subtypes.
details: Supplementary Table S5 supplies 94 chromatographically distinguished glycan features and cell-line aggregate abundance values. Cell-line origin, tumour stage, differentiation and microsatellite status are joined from Table S1 when the source identifier matches exactly. Original antigen, glycan-family and linkage annotations are retained. Typed structures are transcribed from the same-row SNFG diagrams with all unspecified linkages left unknown; repeated compositions remain separate isomer features. Values are cell-line summaries, not individual biological-replicate measurements.
annotation: Source-derived compositions and original labels are retained. 94 source-supported structures are typed; unspecified bonds remain unknown. Unresolved or conflicting structures remain missing with source provenance.

name: glyhub_GPST000079_N
title: Postnatal mouse skeletal-muscle N-glycome
description: Released N-glycans from skeletal muscle at postnatal days 1, 7, 14 and 21, with three source observations at each age.
details: Supplementary Table S5 individual abundance columns are used; derived fold changes, SEMs and group averages are not treated as additional samples. The source isomer identifiers and partial linkage annotations are retained. This matrix supports the study of the digalactose-to-sialic-acid switch during muscle development.
annotation: Source-derived compositions and original annotation fields are preserved; unknown linkages are not inferred.

name: glyhub_GPST000009_O
title: Atlantic salmon epithelial mucin O-glycans
description: O-glycan relative abundances from Atlantic salmon skin, pyloric caeca and distal-intestinal mucins across six geographic and husbandry cohorts from Tasmania, Sweden and Norway.
details: All compatible tissue and cohort measurements are retained in one matrix. Original retention times, peak areas, suggested structures and per-sample MS1-only asterisks remain available in source annotations. Relative abundance is preserved as reported; ionisation differences limit interpretation across different glycan species. Typed structures describe native residue topology with analytical reducing-end reduction documented separately. Unresolved linkages remain unknown; malformed or sulfated structure strings remain as source annotations pending unambiguous representation.
annotation: Source-derived compositions and original labels are retained. 152 source-supported structures are typed; unspecified bonds remain unknown. Unresolved or conflicting structures remain missing with source provenance.

name: glyhub_GPST000604_HS
title: Heparan sulfate disaccharide profiles measured by HILIC-Q-TOF-MS
description: Lyase-derived disaccharides from commercial glycosaminoglycans, cultured human cells, murine tissues, and human urine measured after reductive isotopic aniline labeling.
details: Sample 12C XIC peak areas are summed across observed sodium adducts. Matched 13C internal-standard areas and source-cell provenance are retained in metadata. These are unnormalized instrumental areas, not published absolute amounts. Source zero totals are represented as missing assay values. Source chemistry preserves the 4,5-unsaturated uronic acid and positional sulfation assignments from Supplemental Table S1. Typed composition and structure are missing because the current glyrepr vocabulary does not represent the unsaturated residue; exact source chemistry remains available in rowData.
unit: summed sample 12C XIC peak area, arbitrary units
annotation: Exact source structures and modification counts retained; typed composition missing because DeltaUA is unsupported. No saturated-residue substitution.
quality_notes: Thirteen published HS standard sum cells disagree with their constituent areas. Brain HS replicate 3 duplicates Liver HS replicate 3. Source values are retained with flags.

name: glyhub_GPST000240_N
title: Brugia malayi N-glycans across life stages
description: MALDI-TOF MS peak-area profiles of released glycans from mixed-sex adult worms, microfilariae, adult females and adult males, and L3 larvae.
details: Forty-seven source-assigned molecular features are retained, including features without a quantified assignment in a particular spectrum. Mixed-sex adult and microfilarial material each have an original spectrum and two explicitly labelled biological replicates. Sex-separated adults and L3 larvae have one profile each. Areas are preserved on the source instrumental scale. Unassigned or undetected features remain missing; no zero filling or normalization is applied. Source phosphorylcholine and glucuronic-acid composition components are represented explicitly. Proposed structural diagrams are transcribed and composition-checked against the same source feature rows. Unlabelled bonds are unknown; source ambiguity braces are represented as floating groups without selecting a particular attachment.
unit: MALDI-TOF MS integrated peak area (arbitrary units)
annotation: 47 proposed source structures are encoded with unspecified linkages and floating groups kept uncertain. Source compositions preserve Hex, HexNAc, Fuc, GlcA and phosphorylcholine; analytical anthranilic-acid labeling is recorded separately.
table: Supplementary Table S3, B - MALDI Raw Data

name: glyhub_GPST000297_O
title: Cornu aspersum mucus O-glycan profiles
description: Released glycans from adhesive, lubricating and protective snail mucus, measured by glycomic mass spectrometry after per-deuter-O-methylation.
details: All 14 reported rows of Supplementary Table 9 are retained across three source mucus profiles. Values are the published glycan-peak area percentages. Identical source mass/composition/topology assignments are aligned across samples; conflicting masses or proposed isomers remain distinct. Unreported combinations are missing and no renormalization is applied. O-glycan lubricating and protective reported totals are 25.16% and 99%, respectively, retained as published. Native methyl substituents are preserved separately from analytical derivatization.
annotation: All 13 proposed O-glycan structures are encoded with unknown linkages and source floating-group ambiguity. Native methyl substituents remain explicit.

name: glyhub_GPST000297_N
title: Cornu aspersum mucus N-glycan profiles
description: Released glycans from adhesive, lubricating and protective snail mucus, measured by glycomic mass spectrometry after per-deuter-O-methylation.
details: All 25 reported rows of Supplementary Table 10 are retained across three source mucus profiles. Values are the published glycan-peak area percentages. In Table 10 row 10, the diagram adds an outlined diamond absent from the stated composition; row 11 draws two fucoses while its composition states one. name: glyhub_GPST000562_CS_DS
title: CS/DS disaccharide amounts in A549 and BEAS-2B small extracellular vesicles
description: Four chondroitin/dermatan sulfate disaccharides quantified as fmol in five A549 and six BEAS-2B small-extracellular-vesicle preparations.
details: Amounts derive from enzymatic CS/DS depolymerization and LC-MS/MS integration. D0a4 and D0a6 were distinguished by diagnostic fragments; the original 11 quantitative observations are preserved. The publication reports six preparations per cell line but excludes one A549 CS/DS preparation after a presumed preparation failure; the absent A5 observation is not manufactured. The N-glycan profiles from the same paper are stored under GPST000667.
annotation: Author CS/DS disaccharide codes and sulfate positions are retained. The measured lyase products contain an unsaturated uronic acid that the installed glyrepr vocabulary cannot represent faithfully; typed compositions therefore remain missing rather than substituting saturated HexA. D0a0, D0a4, D0a6 and D0a10 denote zero, 4-O, 6-O and 4,6-di-O-sulfation, respectively.

name: glyhub_GPST000667_N
title: N-glycan profiles of A549 and BEAS-2B small extracellular vesicles and culture media
description: GlycoGenius-derived N-glycan abundance profiles from tumorigenic A549 and non-tumorigenic BEAS-2B small extracellular vesicles, with BEGM and F12 culture-medium profiles from the same study.
details: All four source profile columns are retained. These are single profiles rather than six-replicate glycoproteomic measurements reported elsewhere in the paper. Migration-time-filtered assignments can contain alternative compositions separated by slashes; those alternatives remain explicit and are not arbitrarily resolved. Missing medium signals remain NA. This accession shares its publication with GPST000562, whose CS/DS disaccharides are represented separately because the glycan type and quantification differ.
annotation: H, N and F encode Hex, HexNAc and Fuc. Am and E encode derivatized alpha2,3 and alpha2,6 Neu5Ac; native NeuAc totals are represented as composition, and derivative/linkage counts are retained. Phosphorylation is retained where explicitly reported. Features with incompatible alternative compositions have missing typed composition and retain every author candidate.

name: glyhub_GPST000671_N_Glycoproteomics
title: Site-resolved N-glycoform proportions during influenza infection of A549 cells
description: Complete source N-site glycoforms from Supplementary File 5: union of ten organelle/secreted fraction panels at 0,6,12,18,24 hours after mock, PR8(H1N1), or x31(H3N2) exposure. 3609 protein/site/glycan identities across 90 biological sample observations.
details: Assay values are author site-normalized proportions F:N, not raw signal or whole-sample glycan abundance. All source rows assigned to this glycan class are retained. Features are aligned only by the exact Protein/site/Glycans triplet; source Concat was checked to match this triplet in every row. No within-panel duplicate triplets occur. Union cells for a feature absent from a source panel remain NA with source_coverage=false; source blanks and actual zeros remain separately recoverable. Only quantitative zeros become NA. No curation-stage imputation, renormalization or replicate averaging occurs. O:W raw intensities are preserved in columns O:W of the pinned source extraction and original workbook. The three biological replicates per condition follow the paper; replicate numbers 1:3 encode within-condition source-column order, not demonstrated longitudinal pairing across time or compartment. TMT channels are preserved because assignments change with time. Human, bovine and influenza-virus protein assignments are all retained exactly; the culture host is human A549, but row-level protein organism must be used for protein provenance. Released glycomics is a separate assay/object class.
annotation: Counts are parsed only from explicit author Glycans tokens. HexNAc, Hex, Fuc and NeuAc are preserved; explicit Phospho and Sulfo are retained as P and S substituents. Protein accession and site positions are author assignments, not independently revalidated peptide localization. All observed source sites are single N/S/T positions; ambiguous or multiple source sites would remain untyped. Full glycan structures are not inferred from composition or site.

name: glyhub_GPST000671_N
title: N-glycomes of influenza-infected A549 organelle and secreted fractions
description: 131 released N-glycan chromatographic features in organelle and secreted protein fractions of A549 cells 24 hours after PR8 (H1N1), x31 (H3N2) or mock infection.
details: PGC-LC-MS/MS glycan abundances are author-normalized proportions of all glycans in each sample. Compatible organelle and secreted fractions are combined with explicit compartment and infection metadata. Four biological replicates per condition were planned. The O-glycan secreted x31 block contains only two observations in the deposited quantitative table; missing observations are not invented. Source isomer identifiers and diagnostic evidence are retained. The deposited N-glycan table contains 131 quantitative features, whereas the publication describes 142 identified N-glycan structures; this object reproduces the available quantitative matrix rather than claiming to include undocumented features. The corresponding molecular feature blocks in official Supplementary Data 4 were checked cell-by-cell and match the deposited workbook.
annotation: Source monosaccharide counts and author GlyTouCan accessions are retained. Where an accession resolves to a parseable WURCS structure with composition consistent with the source row, its structure is included. Unresolvable accessions, incompatible compositions and rows without sequence-level structure remain unfilled. Sulfate/phosphate identity is resolved only when the row explicitly names it; ambiguous substitution remains source annotation without a falsely complete composition. Glycans were chemically reduced for measurement; structures represent the source-referenced glycan identity.

Source isomer identifiers and diagnostic evidence are retained. The deposited N-glycan table contains 131 quantitative features, whereas the publication describes 142 identified N-glycan structures; this object reproduces the available quantitative matrix rather than claiming to include undocumented features. The corresponding molecular feature blocks in official Supplementary Data 4 were checked cell-by-cell and match the deposited workbook.
annotation: Source monosaccharide counts and author GlyTouCan accessions are retained. Where an accession resolves to a parseable WURCS structure with composition consistent with the source row, its structure is included. Unresolvable accessions, incompatible compositions and rows without sequence-level structure remain unfilled. Sulfate/phosphate identity is resolved only when the row explicitly names it; ambiguous substitution remains source annotation without a falsely complete composition. Glycans were chemically reduced for measurement; structures represent the source-referenced glycan identity.

name: glyhub_GPST000596_N
title: Platelet N-glycan isomer profiles in control and FUT8-knockout mice
description: Fifty N-glycan chromatographic features quantified in platelet lysates from three control and three FUT8-knockout mouse observations, supporting a study of platelet activation and thrombosis.
details: The assay contains the six original area-under-curve columns C1–C3 and K1–K3. Isomer labels, retention times, precursor charge and mass, glycan class and author-assigned fucosyl linkage are retained. The separate normalized block in the source workbook contains fractions despite its percent heading; it is not duplicated as an independent dataset. Replicate biology beyond the author condition labels is not inferred.
annotation: Explicit total Hex, HexNAc, Fuc, NeuGc and NeuAc counts are used. Distinct chromatographic isomers remain distinct features. Core/outer-arm linkage information is retained as an author annotation and is not expanded into an unsupported complete glycan topology.

name: glyhub_GPST000351_N
title: Plasma N-glycomes of ASGR1- and MRC1-deficient mice under dietary challenge
description: Seventy-two sialic-linkage-resolved plasma N-glycan features across 46 MALDI-TOF-MS observations from a study of hepatic and macrophage glycan-receptor deficiency. Observations include experimental animals and pooled controls.
details: The complete author-renormalized matrix is retained as fractions, with its individual acquisition filenames as observation identifiers. Genotype, diet, sex, sample ID and source group are joined by exact acquisition filename. Pooled controls remain explicitly identified; the source metadata are not reinterpreted as independent animals. Neu5Ac/Neu5Gc linkage-specific derivatization and O-acetylated species are preserved. No additional normalization or imputation is performed.
annotation: H and N encode Hex and HexNAc; F encodes Fuc. Ge/Gl encode alpha2,6/alpha2,3-linked Neu5Gc, E/L encode the corresponding Neu5Ac linkages, and Ac denotes an acetyl substituent. Linkage counts remain in source annotations; composition does not imply a full structure.

name: glyhub_GPST000294_O_Celegans_Development
title: Caenorhabditis elegans developmental O-glycan profiles
description: Complete Supplementary Table S2 of Increasing Complexity of the N-Glycome During Caenorhabditis Development: 20 O-glycan features quantified across six source culture profiles.
details: O-glycans were released by reductive beta-elimination from peptic glycopeptides remaining after PNGase A/F digestion and analyzed without further derivatization by LC-ESI-MS. Source PDF page 18 has calculated m/z, RT, composition and paired observed-m/z/percentage columns for six samples. Only percentage occurrence is quantitative abundance; observed m/z, nd and fragmentation asterisks are annotations. All 20 rows are retained, including same-composition isomers. Quantitative zeros become NA without imputation or renormalization; raw zeros are preserved. Source columns are culture profiles, not six biological replicates of a common condition. Replication for individual S2 profiles is not explicit and remains unknown. The separately distributed N-glycan Table S1 object extracts the reported percentages from mixed retention-time/percentage cells, preserving censored inequalities and unreported values explicitly.
annotation: Explicit author composition tokens provide Hex, HexNAc, dHex, HexA and PC/Me substituent counts. The source Hex3HexNAc1 Hex1Me has four Hex residues and one Me substituent. No Fuc identity is assigned to generic dHex. Linear/branched qualifiers and source isomers remain annotations; no full structure is inferred.

name: glyhub_GPST000214_N_AML_CellLines
title: N-glycan profiles of 21 acute myeloid leukemia cell lines
description: Complete 68-feature released N-glycan fractional-abundance matrix in 21 AML cell lines from Integrated N- and O-Glycomics of Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) Cell Lines.
details: Source assay is the complete individual-glycan block only; following glycan-feature/derived-trait rows are not molecular features. Author-imputed values of 0.01 replacing zeros are preserved exactly as published; this curation does not reverse or add imputation. Only actual quantitative zero values become NA. No renormalization is applied. One source profile column represents each cell line; biological/technical replicate status of the main table is not specified by its headers and is left unknown. The RSD_MOLM-14 sheet is retained as auxiliary variability data rather than appended: biological rep1 overlaps technical replicates, and N-glycan technical and biological panels have different feature denominators. Isomer suffixes are preserved without collapsing rows.
annotation: Counts follow the author legend: H=Hex, N=HexNAc, F=Fuc, S=NeuAc, P=phosphate, Su=sulfate. In typed composition, sulfate uses S and sialic acid uses NeuAc. Structures are not inferred from composition, retention order or mass.

name: glyhub_GPST000294_N_Celegans_L4
title: Caenorhabditis elegans L4 N-glycans across culture and release fractions
description: All 202 molecular-feature rows of Supplementary Table S1, with relative percentages reported for four L4 culture and glycan-release fraction profiles.
details: L4 larvae were grown in liquid or on plates. PNGase F and the subsequent Ar release fractions are separate analytical fractions of these preparations, not four independent biological replicates. The table reports percentages for the second L4 preparations together with retention times from eleven preparations. Only the percentage tokens are used in the abundance assay; embryo and first-preparation retention times are preserved as source annotations. All 202 source rows remain, including 14 with no percentage in any profile. There are 147 exact percentage measurements and 150 source values explicitly reported as >0.1%; censored values have missing numeric abundance and retain their literal inequalities. Unreported percentages remain missing. No threshold substitution or renormalization is performed.
annotation: Each source diagram is transcribed with its displayed topology and residue identity. Unlabelled glycosidic configurations and acceptor positions remain unknown. Explicit author GlyTouCan accessions refine bond information only after residue-labelled topology is verified. PC and methyl substituents retain their source placement uncertainty, including a PC restricted to two candidate GlcNAc residues. Source composition/mass, original table cells, diagram row and review evidence remain available. All 202 rows have parsed, source-backed structures; broad source H/N/F/substituent totals match where a printed composition exists (201 rows). The one row without printed composition is assigned from its diagram. Twelve explicit GlyTouCan identifiers have residue-labelled topology verification. Row 196 uses the article Results identification of Figure 4I as a branched Man-HexNAc motif to constrain both fragments to the upper-arm Man; row 197 retains uncertain arm placement of long and short chains.

name: glyhub_GPST000296_N_Glycoproteomics
title: Site-specific N-glycoproteome of oral squamous-cell carcinoma tissues
description: Quantitative N-glycopeptide profiles of 30 oral squamous-cell carcinoma tumour tissues, comprising 12 node-negative and 18 node-positive samples.
details: The 3,117 author-grouped UniProt, protein-site and glycan-composition features are retained. Reporter ion intensities were divided by the pooled reference channel within each TMT experiment and normalized to each channel total. Source NaN values remain missing; numerical zeros become NA. No reaggregation or imputation is applied. The companion released-glycan dataset has a different molecular observation unit and is retained separately.
annotation: Compositions are transcribed directly from the Glycan field. Protein positions come from the author glycopeptide identifier and agree with every reported Glycosite entry. Peptide-relative positions and peptide starts are retained separately; all reported start plus relative-position coordinates agree with the protein absolute position. Representative peptide sequences cannot consistently validate every PSM-relative position, so original fields and a residue-consistency flag are retained without changing the author site. No site-specific glycan topology is inferred from companion released-glycan diagrams.
